# Retrieve previously cached flight results for outbound and return legs
flights = get_results_from_cache(key="flights")
return_flights = get_results_from_cache(key="return_flights")
hotels = get_results_from_cache(key="hotels")

# Since the user requested a round-trip flight, we need to search for return flights separately.
# However, since return_flights is already cached, we can use it directly.

# Filter flights to include only economy class
filtered_outbound = filter_flights(prior_results=flights, flight_class=["economy"])
filtered_return = filter_flights(prior_results=return_flights, flight_class=["economy"])

# Save filtered results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_outbound_flights", value=filtered_outbound)
save_to_cache(key="filtered_return_flights", value=filtered_return)

# Retrieve filtered flight results
outbound_flights = get_results_from_cache(key="filtered_outbound_flights")
return_flights_filtered = get_results_from_cache(key="filtered_return_flights")

# Combine outbound and return flights into a single round-trip result
round_trip_flights = {
    "search_results": [
        {"outbound": outbound_flights, "return": return_flights_filtered}
    ],
    "query_summary": "Round-trip economy flights from San Jose to Portland (May 22, 2025 - May 25, 2025) and return flights from Portland to San Jose (May 25, 2025)."
}

# Save round-trip flight results to cache
save_to_cache(key="round_trip_flights", value=round_trip_flights)

# Filter hotels to include only 3-star hotels
filtered_hotels = filter_hotels(prior_results=hotels, stars=[3])

# Save filtered hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_hotels", value=filtered_hotels)

# Retrieve filtered hotel results
filtered_hotel_results = get_results_from_cache(key="filtered_hotels")

# Prepare final response
response = {
    "flights": round_trip_flights,
    "hotels": filtered_hotel_results
}

print(response)
